Renee (AtlasFlow): Quick heads-up - our CI warmup started failing after we flipped to the new JS SDK. Seeing intermittent 401s that say "unauthorized" and short bursts of 429s. Staging only.
Kai (CSM): thanks Reneé. Which SDK version and where do tokens come from (CI service or vault)? Looping Arun + Luca.
Renee (AtlasFlow): SDK 1.7.0, tokens minted by our ephemeral token service. Sample log: `POST /v1/embeddings 401 {id:\"req_xxx\", error:\"unauthorized\", hint:\"missing auth header\"}`. But `curl` from the same runner works.
Arun (SDK): common issues: 1) header forwarding lost at fanout edge 2) very short token TTL + clock skew 3) client retries ignoring Retry-After:0. What's your fanout pattern?
Renee (AtlasFlow): GH Actions triggers a tiny lambda that fans out 30 parallel requests using fetch(). We set TTL=45s to be safe.
Luca (SRE): 45s is risky for large parallel work. Also many edge runtimes strip Authorization when using certain fetch patterns. I can see traces showing empty auth at the edge for some of your requests.
Kai (CSM): quick fixes to try: whitelist Authorization in your lambda's forwarder, add 0-300ms startup jitter to workers, and increase TTL to 5min or implement per-worker refresh. Arun, any SDK knobs?
Arun (SDK): yes - enable `respectRetryAfter` and lower maxAttempts during warmup. Example: `retry:{respectRetryAfter:true,maxAttempts:3,minTimeout:300}`. There's also an `authFallback` opt-in to send creds as a query param when header missing.
Renee (AtlasFlow): will whitelist header and add jitter. Can we get a temporary onboarding throttle bump while we stabilize?
TicketBot: Ops ticket created: OPS-4999 "AtlasFlow onboarding temporary increase" 1h watch assigned to infra-ops.
Luca (SRE): re-run after changes and I'll watch traces. If you keep short TTLs, consider token exchange (long-lived per runner -> short-lived per request).
Renee (AtlasFlow): update - whitelisted Authorization, bumped TTL to 5m, added 0-250ms splay. Re-ran 4 warmups: 401s disappeared, 429s dropped from ~16% to ~2%. Thanks all.
Kai (CSM): great! Arun, can you add a short note to onboarding docs about header whitelisting and jitter?
Arun (SDK): will submit a tiny docs PR and propose a safer default for retry behavior in warmup guides.
Renee (AtlasFlow): closing the thread unless it returns. :wave:
